name: BMW × Figure: Figure 02 at Plant Spartanburg
summary: Figure 02 loaded sheet-metal parts in the body shop.
body: BMW says Figure 02 supported production of more than 30,000 BMW X3 over ten months in 2025. Figure describes an 11-month deployment, over 90,000 parts loaded and 1,250 hours of operation. Unit count not confirmed by BMW.

use_case.v: Inserting sheet-metal parts in the body shop
